text.p: The following are some leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Infant mortality fell 8.5 percent in 1996 to 6.9 per thousand, the lowest rate ever in Portugal. Madeira island is the only region to show an increase, rising from 10.8 to 11.9 per thousand children.
- EDP-Electricidade de Portugal will choose a strategic partner after the summer and only then is the governmnet going to decide when the second privatisation phase will take place.
- Among European Union's small and medium companies, the Portuguese are the ones that resort most to European Union funds, an annual study by Grant Thorton International said.
- Spanish electricity company Endesa is still trying to buy a stake in EDP, despite not receiving any shares in the privatisation, banking sources tell the weekly newspaper.
- Portugal falls to last place on the ranking of major fishing countries, Pedro Franca, chairman of the association of shipowners of industrial fishing, said.
